 Advertisement Updated: 12:12 AM CDT Oct 29, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Taylor Lang Digital Content Manager Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Parade: What we know
 Updated: 12:12 AM CDT Oct 29, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Taylor Lang Digital Content Manager MILWAUKEE — MAKING HISTORY | MERCHANDISE | MVP | REACTION | MKE GIVEAWAYS 
 Brewers make history! Brew Crew, now is the time to celebrate our first World Series title. 
 Advertisement In World Series tradition, Milwaukee will hold a parade to celebrate our beloved team.
 >> CLICK HERE TO GET YOUR MLB BREWERS WORLD SERIES MERCH << 
 Here's what we know.
 Parade date
 The parade will be on Friday. It will start at 10 a.m.
 There will be exclusive merchandise during the celebration.
 Parade route
 Watch News Chopper 12 fly the route of the parade in the video player above. 
 The championship parade will start the intersection of N. 4th Street and W. Wisconsin Avenue. It will go through downtown Milwaukee before concluding at Henry Maier Festival Park (HMFP), where a rally will take place throughout the grounds. 
 Hearst Owned 
 Admission to the general HMFP grounds will be free to all fans until capacity is reached.
 HMFP will open to the public at 8 a.m. to accommodate fans. There will be multiple large video screens featuring live parade coverage, along with live music, food and drinks.
 Rally speech tickets
 Tickets to be seated in the American Family Insurance Amphitheater for the rally speeches will be available starting at 10 a.m. on Thursday and the public on sale at 2 p.m.
 As with postseason Watch Parties, net proceeds from Amphitheater ticket sales will benefit Brewers Community Foundation. The rally speeches will be available on various video boards throughout the HMFP grounds.
 Street closings
 Fans should expect the streets of the parade route to be closed and traffic delays around the time of the parade.
 School closings
 No school districts have closed schools for the parade at this time. There are a few districts that had the day planned off already for other calendar reasons.
 Forecast
 There are rain chances ahead for SE Wisconsin through Tuesday. 
 This is a developing story. Stay with WISN 12 News for the latest information.
